moneyIntro: Optional. The app works in units; with these it also shows money.
deviceOnly: These values stay on this device. They never leave this browser and are never sent anywhere.
currencyHint: Just a label shown next to amounts.
bankrollUnset: Without a bankroll and a unit value, everything is shown in units.
moneyCleared: Bankroll and unit cleared from this device.
presetsIntro: Filter combinations saved from the Explorer or the Simulator.
cacheNote: The script keeps its read of the sheet for {minutes} minutes so it does not reload it on every visit, so refreshing can bring data up to {minutes} minutes old.

redactionsNote.one: The script hid {n} money-like text in the notes.
redactionsNote.other: The script hid {n} money-like texts in the notes.

aboutBody: Bets Tracker shows the “Bets Tracker with Claude” sheet read-only: it never writes to the sheet and keeps no money from the sheet.
